ASUS TS100-E11-PI4 Intel Xeon E-2334 Tower Server

The ASUS TS100-E11-PI4 Tower Server is powered by an Intel Xeon E-2334 Processor, clocked at 3.60GHz (up to 4.80GHz), with 4 cores and 8 threads. This server ensures seamless multitasking and fast processing. It comes with 16GB of RAM and supports up to 128GB, making it capable of handling demanding workloads and data-intensive applications. The server offers excellent storage options with 2 x 1TB SATA3 ENTERPRISE 6Gbps hard drives and supports software RAID 0, 1, 10 & 5 using Intel Rapid Storage Technology Enterprise (RSTe). Two Intel I210-AT LAN ports as well as a management port provide strong connectivity. Along with numerous USB ports, the server has VGA, HDMI (which can only be used with an iGPU), and audio jacks. Server management is made simple and effective with the ASUS Control Center Enterprise and ASMB10-iKVM card. The Aspeed AST2510 graphics card has 64MB VRAM and an 80PLUS Single Power Supply with a 300W rating, which further improves both performance and reliability. The ASUS TS100-E11-PI4 is a versatile and dependable server solution for businesses that is compatible with a number of operating systems, including Windows Server 2019, Windows Server 2016, RedHat Enterprise Linux, SuSE Linux Enterprise Server, CentOS, and VMware.

PCIe 4.0 Ready for Enhanced Performance

The ASUS TS100-E11-PI4 embraces the cutting-edge PCIe 4.0 technology, delivering 16 GT/s bandwidth, double the speed of PCIe 3.0. This enables lower power consumption, better lane scalability, and backwards compatibility, ensuring flexible scalability for demanding workloads.

Robust Server-Management Solution

ASUS TS100-E11-PI4 incorporates the ASUS ASMB10-iKVM, a powerful server-management solution based on the ASPEED 2600 chipset and AMI MegaRAC SP-X. It enables out-of-band server management through WebGUI, IPMI, and Redfish API, streamlining server administration and ensuring seamless control.

Enhanced Security

The ASUS TS100-E11-PI4 integrates PFR FPGA as the platform Root-of-Trust solution, it ensures firmware resiliency, safeguarding your infrastructure from potential hackers. The server is also fully compliant with the 2018 NIST SP 800 193 specification and includes support for Trusted Platform Module 2.0 (TPM 2.0) to secure hardware through integrated cryptographic keys and firmware updates for vulnerabilities.
